name: GLP J-REIT
summary: GLP J-REIT is a real estate investment corporation (J-REIT) specializing in logistics facilities, and it primarily invests in modern logistics facilities. GLP J-REIT was founded in accordance with the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations with GLP Japan Advisors Inc. (hereinafter the Asset Manager) as the founder. It has its units listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange since December 21, 2012. Investing in highly functional modern logistics facilities and taking advantage of the wealth of experience and management resources with GLP Japan Inc. (Note) as the sponsor, GLP J-REIT aims to earn stable income and achieve steady growth in assets…
